# Architecture Doc

> Build formal Estate-branded architecture and system-design artifacts for a client, grounded in source material with every claim sourced and brand and prose gates applied.

**What it does.** Build formal Estate-branded architecture and system-design documents for a client, grounded in named sources with every claim sourced and the brand and prose gates applied. Covers architecture intent (what and why) plus engineering views: components, interfaces, data model, APIs, serving path, deployment, and trade-offs.

**Use it when.** For a client-facing architecture document, platform architecture, architecture reference, or a sourced technical design document, even if the user does not say Estate.

**Not for.** Do NOT use for a fast, unbranded, inline working design or exploratory architecture discussion (that is system-design), a client proposal or SOW (solution-brief, sow), or a journey map (journey-mapping).
